local-admin.subject: local-admin
local-admin.label: Tenant administrator (development bundle)
local-admin.description: Primary tenant. Elevated access to administration, content and operations. Independent review and OAuth limits still apply.

local-reader.subject: local-reader
local-reader.label: Reader and discovery (development bundle)
local-reader.description: Primary tenant. Trusted-reader workflow: private local reads, external discovery, saved items, eligible ratings and own feedback.

local-contributor.subject: local-contributor
local-contributor.label: Contributor (development bundle)
local-contributor.description: Primary tenant. Authoring, publisher creation, discovery, saved items, eligible ratings and own feedback. A different reviewer must approve.

local-reviewer.subject: local-reviewer
local-reviewer.label: Reviewer (development bundle)
local-reviewer.description: Primary tenant. Independent review, private local reads, discovery, saved items, eligible ratings and own feedback.

local-publisher.subject: local-publisher
local-publisher.label: Publisher (development bundle)
local-publisher.description: Primary tenant. Release publication and discovery snapshots, discovery, saved items, eligible ratings and own feedback.

other-tenant-admin.subject: other-admin
other-tenant-admin.label: Other-tenant administrator (development bundle)
other-tenant-admin.description: Separate tenant. Elevated administration; its records and grants are isolated from the primary tenant.

local-template-reader.subject: local-template-reader
local-template-reader.label: Reader (exact template)
local-template-reader.description: Primary tenant. Local metadata, history, retained content and Explore; eligible personal ratings. No authoring or external discovery.

local-template-contributor.subject: local-template-contributor
local-template-contributor.label: Contributor (exact template)
local-template-contributor.description: Primary tenant. Resource authoring, validation and review submission; publisher creation is separate.

local-template-reviewer.subject: local-template-reviewer
local-template-reviewer.label: Reviewer (exact template)
local-template-reviewer.description: Primary tenant. Resource evidence and independent review decisions; no authoring or release publication.

local-template-publisher.subject: local-template-publisher
local-template-publisher.label: Publisher (exact template)
local-template-publisher.description: Primary tenant. Publish approved releases and change release lifecycle; discovery snapshots are separate.

local-template-tenant-admin.subject: local-template-tenant-admin
local-template-tenant-admin.label: Tenant administrator (exact template)
local-template-tenant-admin.description: Primary tenant. All tenant tasks; OAuth ceilings, independent review and disabled capabilities still apply.

local-template-discovery-reader.subject: local-template-discovery-reader
local-template-discovery-reader.label: Discovery reader (exact template)
local-template-discovery-reader.description: Primary tenant. External discovery, published snapshots, publisher reads, saved items and eligible ratings. No local Resource reads or operational Jobs.

local-template-publisher-creator.subject: local-template-publisher-creator
local-template-publisher-creator.label: Publisher creator (exact template)
local-template-publisher-creator.description: Primary tenant. Read and create publishers; no publisher updates or domain approval.

local-template-publication-admin.subject: local-template-publication-admin
local-template-publication-admin.label: Publication administrator (exact template)
local-template-publication-admin.description: Primary tenant. Manage eligible audience snapshots and their Jobs without private Resource API reads. Release publication is separate.

local-template-source-admin.subject: local-template-source-admin
local-template-source-admin.label: Source administrator (exact template)
local-template-source-admin.description: Primary tenant. Inspect and manage federation sources, sync and eligible Jobs; no local authoring.

local-template-security-reviewer.subject: local-template-security-reviewer
local-template-security-reviewer.label: Security reviewer (exact template)
local-template-security-reviewer.description: Primary tenant. Read/export private tenant audit context without Resource API reads. Token scopes and current audit admission apply.

local-template-webhook-admin.subject: local-template-webhook-admin
local-template-webhook-admin.label: Webhook administrator (exact template)
local-template-webhook-admin.description: Primary tenant. Manage enabled webhooks and delivery evidence; no local resource reads.

local-template-feedback-member.subject: local-template-feedback-member
local-template-feedback-member.label: Feedback member (exact template)
local-template-feedback-member.description: Primary tenant. Read, edit and withdraw existing own feedback; new reports need separate resource-read permission.

local-template-library-member.subject: local-template-library-member
local-template-library-member.label: Library member (exact template)
local-template-library-member.description: Primary tenant. Manage own saved references and named searches; no resource reads or administration.

local-template-service-client.subject: local-template-service-client
local-template-service-client.label: Service client (exact template; nonhuman)
local-template-service-client.description: Primary tenant. Nonhuman identity with an empty template. No product permissions or human-only tasks; authenticated self and service reads remain available.
